summary: Firefox broadened CSS support and improved how CSS values are represented and inspected, including `grid-lanes`, CSS Typed OM transforms, and scroll-driven animation timing. It also adds HTML-standard default styles for elements such as `option`, `optgroup`, and `legend`, supports the `chain` value for `overscroll-behavior`, and improves font metrics and color handling. Many of the remaining changes are internal cleanups that make CSS properties and browser style data more consistent.
